text: Planning a trip can be exciting but also a bit stressful. When you visit a new country, you experience different cultures, which helps you understand the world better. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, and it can be delicious or surprising. However, language barriers can make things difficult. Sometimes you need to use hand gestures or simple words to communicate. Even small problems become funny stories later. In the end, travel creates memories that stay with you forever, and you often learn more about yourself along the way.
